torque_definition: MuJoCo inverse dynamics reconstructed at observed q,dq,ddq; not physical torque sensing
description: descriptive analysis only; no model selection on T13/T14

nearest_legacy_distance_12d.definition: Euclidean nearest distance in q(rad)+dq(rad/s), each dimension scaled by max(legacy std,0.05); 5-row stride

coverage.interpretation: q/dq 1D bounds and standardized 12D proximity only; not full 18D coverage. Legacy ddq used wall-time differencing and new ddq uses filtered simulation time, so acceleration ranges are not directly comparable.

similarity.metric: 6-joint planned position RMS after resampling motion to 201 normalized times
